variants.after: Yet, as you navigate the crowded alleys, the memory of the almoner's terrified eyes lingers; the whispered promise you traded for his silence remains a dangerous, unpaid debt waiting in the shadows.
Far below the roaring crowds, the almoner's broken body lies undiscovered upon the cobblestones, a grim and silent secret that ensures your fatal push will never be traced back to you.
Even amidst the riotous distraction, you keep your collar turned high against the morning chill, keenly aware that your uncovered features are already circulating on fresh warrants across the city.

Watching the mob tear at the estates of Valerius and Rigg, you share a grim smile with Sable, burdened by the secret knowledge of the vault's counter-ledgers: the warring houses were always a single, orchestrated cabal.
Tucked safely in your pocket is a heavy seal of Valerian silk, a quiet guarantee from the polite lord that his hidden enforcers will look the other way as you and Sable disappear into the smoke.

Matron Rigg's iron-stamped warrant of transit sits heavy against your ribs, a brutal but effective shield guaranteeing that her foundry guards will ignore your quiet exodus from the bleeding district.
The rough wool of your porter's livery blends seamlessly with the soot-stained attire of the rioting dockworkers, transforming you into just another nameless labourer among the angry, surging masses.
